summary: The Rams are the better team on the season numbers, a margin of 6.1 points per game against 0.5 for Green Bay, and they arrive on a four-game winning streak. The books agree, making Los Angeles a small favourite at 2.5 points. I pass on all three markets. The spread has moved from 3.5 to 2.5 for Green Bay, and nothing in the data shows the new number is wrong. Recent form rests on three to five games, and Green Bay has the better yards per play over the last three. Green Bay won all four meetings the data holds, a small sample. Both teams have had ten days of rest and the game is in a dome, so neither rest nor weather separates them. The Rams list three players out, including two on the offensive line and a tight end, but the data does not say how much that matters. The total has dropped from 45.5 to 43.5, and I cannot show the price misses anything in the scoring figures. Props are not covered and both quarterbacks are projections.
